# Files and libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tictoc)
library(statpsych)
```

```{r}
# TE df with fractional occupancy; has a few hundred fewer genes than the other TE df
TE <- readxl::read_excel("/Users/samuelmondal/Documents/Translation/TE_readjustment/Total_unified_extrapolation/Total_unified_TE_extrapolation.xlsx")
#TE <- readxl::read_excel("/Users/samuelmondal/Documents/Translation/TE_readjustment/Total_unified_extrapolation/Total_unified_TE_extrapolation_alternate.xlsx")
gtAI <- readxl::read_excel("/Users/samuelmondal/Documents/Translation/TE_readjustment/gtAI/Table 4.XLSX",sheet = "Saccharomyces cerevisiae")
refseq_name <- read.delim(file = "/Users/samuelmondal/Documents/Translation/TE_readjustment/gtAI/uniprotkb_saccharomyces_cerevisiae_AND_2025_04_03.tsv", sep = "\t")
splt <- separate(gtAI, col = `gene id`, into = paste0("V", 1:6),
         sep = "_", fill = "right", remove = FALSE)$V5
gtAI$RefSeq <- paste0("NP_",splt)
refseq_name <- refseq_name %>% drop_na(RefSeq)
refseq_name$RefSeq <- vapply(strsplit(refseq_name$RefSeq,"[;& ]+"), `[`, 1, FUN.VALUE=character(1))
refseq_name <- refseq_name %>% rename(SystematicName = Gene.Names..ordered.locus.,Gene = Gene.Names..primary.) %>% select(SystematicName,Gene,RefSeq)
gtAI <- merge(refseq_name,gtAI)
gtAI <- gtAI %>% select(SystematicName,tAI)
TE <- merge(gtAI,TE)
```

```{r}
Riba <- readxl::read_excel("/Users/samuelmondal/Documents/Translation/TE_readjustment/Total_unified_extrapolation/Riba_TE_extrapolation.xlsx")
Riba <- merge(gtAI,Riba)
```

```{r}
plot_theme <-theme(legend.position = "right",
              legend.title = element_text(size=16,hjust = 0.5),
              legend.background = element_rect(colour="black"),
              legend.text = element_text(size=16),
              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 0),
              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),   
              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), 
              panel.background = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank(),
              axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))

col <- c("ES" = "green","TE" = "blue","thalf" = "red")
colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = "Control coefficient",
                                 values = col,
                                 labels = c("ES" = expression("Speed vs "*tAI), 
                                            "TE" = expression("TE vs "*tAI),
                                            "thalf" = expression(RNA~t[1/2]~vs~tAI)))

fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(name = "Control coefficient",
                                 values = col,
                                 labels = c("ES" = expression("Speed vs "*tAI), 
                                            "TE" = expression("TE vs "*tAI),
                                            "thalf" = expression(RNA~t[1/2]~vs~tAI)))
```

# Extrapolated total TE

```{r}
extrapolated_tot <- TE %>% drop_na(total_unified_TE,thalf,MeanNumberOfRibosomes) %>%
  mutate(total_unified_ES = (total_unified_TE*CDSLength)/(1000*MeanNumberOfRibosomes)) %>%
  arrange(CDSLength)
```

```{r}
extrapolated_tot %>%
  mutate(total_unified_ES = total_unified_ES/median(total_unified_ES),
         total_unified_TE = total_unified_TE/median(total_unified_TE),
         thalf = thalf/median(thalf)) %>%
   summarise(num_genes = n(),
            min_CDS = min(CDSLength),
            max_CDS = max(CDSLength),
            avg_CDS = mean(CDSLength),
            {ES_tAI <- ci.theil(alpha = 0.05, total_unified_ES, tAI)
            tibble(ES_tAI_slope = ES_tAI[1],
                   ES_tAI_CI_low = ES_tAI[3],
                   ES_tAI_CI_high = ES_tAI[4])},
            {TE_tAI <- ci.theil(alpha = 0.05, total_unified_TE, tAI)
            tibble(TE_tAI_slope = TE_tAI[1],
                   TE_tAI_CI_low = TE_tAI[3],
                   TE_tAI_CI_high = TE_tAI[4])},
            {thalf_tAI <- ci.theil(alpha = 0.05, thalf, tAI)
            tibble(thalf_tAI_slope = thalf_tAI[1],
                   thalf_tAI_CI_low = thalf_tAI[3],
                   thalf_tAI_CI_high = thalf_tAI[4])})
```

## UCSF selection III

```{r}
extrapolated_tot_III <- extrapolated_tot %>%
  mutate(CDS_bins_400 = cut(CDSLength,breaks=c(min(CDSLength),
                                               400,
                                               800,
                                               1200,
                                               1800,
                                               max(CDSLength)),
                            include.lowest = TRUE))
```

```{r}
extrapolated_tot_CDS_400_UCSF_III <- extrapolated_tot_III %>%
  mutate(total_unified_ES = total_unified_ES/median(total_unified_ES),
         total_unified_TE = total_unified_TE/median(total_unified_TE),
         thalf = thalf/median(thalf)) %>%
  group_by(CDS_bins_400) %>%
  summarise(num_genes = n(),
            min_CDS = min(CDSLength),
            max_CDS = max(CDSLength),
            avg_CDS = mean(CDSLength),
            {ES_tAI <- ci.theil(alpha = 0.05, total_unified_ES, tAI)
            tibble(ES_tAI_slope = ES_tAI[1],
                   ES_tAI_CI_low = ES_tAI[3],
                   ES_tAI_CI_high = ES_tAI[4])},
            {TE_tAI <- ci.theil(alpha = 0.05, total_unified_TE, tAI)
            tibble(TE_tAI_slope = TE_tAI[1],
                   TE_tAI_CI_low = TE_tAI[3],
                   TE_tAI_CI_high = TE_tAI[4])},
            {thalf_tAI <- ci.theil(alpha = 0.05, thalf, tAI)
            tibble(thalf_tAI_slope = thalf_tAI[1],
                   thalf_tAI_CI_low = thalf_tAI[3],
                   thalf_tAI_CI_high = thalf_tAI[4])})
```

## Theil Sen vs OLS plots

800-1200 bp bin for thalf and TE

```{r}
library(mblm)
```

```{r}
equation_string <- function(lst) {
  slope <- round(coef(lst)[2],2)
  intercept <- round(coef(lst)[1],2)
  sign <- ifelse(sign(intercept) == -1, "-", "+")
  intercept <- intercept*sign(intercept)
  string <- sprintf("y = %.2fx %s %.2f",slope,sign,intercept)
  return(string)
}
```

```{r}
bin_of_interest <- extrapolated_tot_III %>% 
  mutate(total_unified_ES = total_unified_ES/median(total_unified_ES),
         total_unified_TE = total_unified_TE/median(total_unified_TE),
         thalf = thalf/median(thalf)) %>%
  filter(CDS_bins_400 == "(800,1.2e+03]")
```

```{r}
OLS_line_TE <- lm(data = bin_of_interest, total_unified_TE~tAI)
TS_line_TE <- mblm(dataframe = bin_of_interest, total_unified_TE~tAI, repeated = FALSE)
OLS_line_thalf <- lm(data = bin_of_interest, thalf~tAI)
TS_line_thalf <- mblm(dataframe = bin_of_interest, thalf~tAI, repeated = FALSE)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = bin_of_interest, aes(x=tAI, y=total_unified_TE)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = coef(OLS_line_TE)[1],
              slope = coef(OLS_line_TE)[2],
              linetype="OLS"),     
              linewidth = 1,
              colour = "blue") +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = coef(TS_line_TE)[1],
              slope = coef(TS_line_TE)[2],
              linetype = "Theil-Sen"),     
              linewidth = 1,
              colour = "blue") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Theil-Sen" = "solid", "OLS" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Regression") +
  labs(x = "tAI", y = "Norm. TE",
       title = "Regression corrected unified TE CDS bin: (800,1200]") +
  plot_theme +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 6, limits = c(0,13.55)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.32,0.6))
```

```{r}
equation_string(OLS_line_TE)
equation_string(TS_line_TE)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = bin_of_interest, aes(x=tAI, y=thalf)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = coef(OLS_line_thalf)[1],
              slope = coef(OLS_line_thalf)[2],
              linetype="OLS"),     
              linewidth = 1,
              colour = "blue") +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = coef(TS_line_thalf)[1],
              slope = coef(TS_line_thalf)[2],
              linetype = "Theil-Sen"),     
              linewidth = 1,
              colour = "blue") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Theil-Sen" = "solid", "OLS" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Regression") +
  labs(x = "tAI", y = expression("Norm. RNA "*t[1/2]),
       title = "Regression corrected unified TE CDS bin: (800,1200];") +
  plot_theme +
  lims(y = c(0,4), x = c(0.32,0.6))
```

```{r}
equation_string(OLS_line_thalf)
equation_string(TS_line_thalf)
```

```{r}
# Two plots in one
ggplot(data = bin_of_interest) +

  geom_point(aes(x = tAI, y = thalf, colour = "thalf"), alpha = 0.5) +

                  slope = coef(TS_line_thalf)[2],
                  colour = "thalf"),     
              linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 6, limits = c(0.32,0.6)) +      
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 6, limits = c(0,8)) +
  labs(x = "tAI", y = expression(atop("TE (norm.)", paste("RNA  "*t[1/2]*" (norm.)"))),

  scale_colour_manual(name = "Theil-Sen line", values = c("TE" = "blue", "thalf" = "red"),

  plot_theme
```

```{r}
  mutate(coller_total_Riba = TE_riba*coller_ratio,
```

```{r}
# Depending of Pearson or Spearman, uncomment the correct command
bullk_cor_val <- cor(corr_extrapolated_riba[c(2,4,13,14,34,36)], method = "spearman")

```

```{r}
# Output deom colnames is [1] "tAI"               "thalf"             "TE_riba"           "TE_riba_RiboZero"  "total_Riba_TE"    [6] "coller_total_Riba"
colnames(bullk_cor_val) <- rownames(bullk_cor_val) <- c("tAI",
                                                        "HL",
                                                        "polyA",
                                                        "RiboZero",
                                                        "Regression C.",
                                                        "Coller C.")

ggcorrplot(bullk_cor_val, lab = TRUE, lab_size = 10) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(limit = c(0,1), 
                       low = "blue", 
                       high =  "red", 
                       mid = "white",

                       #name = "Spearman's ρ"

    theme(legend.position = "right",
          text=element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.title = element_text(size=20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold",
                                      margin = margin(1,1,10,1)),
          legend.text = element_text(size=20, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.spacing.y = unit(2.0, 'cm'),
          axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 20, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, colour = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, colour = "black"),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = TE_tAI_CI_low, ymax = TE_tAI_CI_high,fill = "TE"), 
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y=thalf_tAI_slope,colour = "thalf")) +
  geom_line(aes(y=thalf_tAI_slope,colour = "thalf")) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = thalf_tAI_CI_low, ymax = thalf_tAI_CI_high,fill = "thalf"), 
              alpha = 0.2) +
  colour_scale +
  fill_scale +
  labs(x = "CDS length (nt)", y = "Control coefficient",
       title = "Riba RiboZero TE (650 genes; gene set common with total unified)") +
  plot_theme
```
